summary: Display review summary in product page header using existing review data; no API, schema or storage changes, single repo UI-only update.

steps.why: Convert ticket into implementable story with acceptance criteria for the UI changes.
steps.instructions: Focus on the UI state management after review submission and the display logic for zero-review vs. multiple-review cases.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Only one spec document (the inline story); no cross-artifact consistency to check.

checks.why: No API, schema, queue, database, config, endpoint, parameter, field, job, table, event, message format or setting is added or changed; the ticket explicitly states existing review data and services stay as they are.

The ticket clearly states what changes: header display of rating summary, Reviews tab title, zero-review handling, and UI update after review submission; a developer can code this directly from the ticket.
All changes are part of one cohesive UI update on the product page; no separate stories are needed.
